tasks.task: Add PostgreSQL configuration to zitadel module
acceptance_criteria: User 'zitadel' is ensured to exist with DB ownership
Authentication configured for local socket and md5

tasks.note: Confirmed against zitadel v2.71.7's cmd/defaults.yaml (the version pinned in nixpkgs at this flake's rev): Database.postgres.Admin.ExistingDatabase defaults to 'postgres', meaning Zitadel's init/admin connection targets the 'postgres' maintenance DB, not the 'zitadel' DB, unless overridden. Since pg_hba is scoped per-database (local zitadel ... md5), Admin.ExistingDatabase is explicitly set to 'zitadel' so that connection matches the scoped rule instead of falling through to the untouched 'local all postgres peer' default. Also confirmed via cmd/zitadel.go that multiple --config files are merged with viper.MergeInConfig (recursive/deep merge), so splitting Database.postgres.User.Password and Admin.Password into the runtime secrets file while the rest of Database.postgres stays in the generated store file is safe.
acceptance_criteria: Database.postgres configured for Unix socket connection
extraSettingsPaths includes runtime secrets file path

tasks.task: Add firewall rules to zitadel module
tasks.note: Implemented via services.zitadel.openFirewall = true (upstream module option) rather than a manual networking.firewall.allowedTCPPorts entry, to avoid duplicating the port declaration. Verified with a real evaluation (not just --parse): a scratch nixosSystem importing modules/zitadel.nix with custom.zitadel.enable = true was built via `nix-instantiate --eval -A config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath`, which forces the full module fixpoint and all NixOS assertions to resolve. It succeeded, and config.services.zitadel.settings / config.services.postgresql.authentication rendered as expected (pg_hba rules for zitadel db correctly inserted above the module defaults). This is stronger than task 4.1's dependency ordering suggests is needed before any evaluation is possible -- worth doing this kind of scratch eval again after Phase 3/4 changes rather than waiting for a full colmena build.

Added a redirectUrl option too (not in the original scope), holding the full literal redirect URL rather than deriving it inside the module -- same shape as zitadel.nix taking domain verbatim instead of assembling it from parts.
acceptance_criteria: Module defines options for: port, zitadelDomain, cookieDomain
Module defines options for: clientId, clientSecretFile, cookieSecretFile

tasks.note: clientSecretFile/cookieSecretFile as options on the upstream module don't exist -- checked nixos/modules/services/security/oauth2-proxy.nix at this flake's pinned nixpkgs rev directly. services.oauth2-proxy.clientSecret and cookie.secret are plain nullOr str that get baked into the generated ExecStart command line (Nix store + ps aux visible); there's no *File variant. Used the module's own documented escape hatch: a systemd.services.oauth2-proxy-env helper unit writes OAUTH2_PROXY_CLIENT_SECRET/OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECRET into a runtime-only /run/oauth2-proxy/env file, wired in via services.oauth2-proxy.keyFile (which upstream maps straight to systemd's EnvironmentFile=). Confirmed with a scratch nixosSystem eval that the rendered ExecStart contains neither client-secret nor cookie-secret, and EnvironmentFile=/run/oauth2-proxy/env is set. clientId is NOT treated as secret (matches Phase 9.2's plan to set it as a literal string in hosts/auth.nix), so it's passed directly as services.oauth2-proxy.clientID, not through the env file.

code-challenge-method and pass-authorization-header aren't declared options on the upstream module (checked the source directly) -- both set via extraConfig, which the module merges as raw hyphenated flags. Two gotchas this task list didn't anticipate, both confirmed against primary sources: (1) upstream's passBasicAuth defaults to true and emits --pass-basic-auth=true, setting an empty Basic Authorization header that would clobber the Bearer token pass-authorization-header is meant to forward -- explicitly set passBasicAuth = false. (2) oauth2-proxy 7.9.0 (the version pinned in nixpkgs here) refuses to start at all without email-domain, authenticated-emails-file, or an htpasswd file configured (pkg/validation/options.go: 'missing setting for email validation') -- hardcoded email.domains = [ "*" ] since Zitadel is the actual authorization boundary here, not oauth2-proxy.
acceptance_criteria: upstream set to 'static://200' for ForwardAuth mode

tasks.task: Add firewall rules to oauth2-proxy module
tasks.note: Also fixed httpAddress, which this task list didn't cover and which would have silently broken Phase 6.5/10.3: upstream defaults httpAddress to http://127.0.0.1:4180 (loopback-only), but Traefik reaches oauth2-proxy across the LAN from a different host (192.168.50.125:4180 per Phase 5), so it must bind 0.0.0.0. Set httpAddress = "http://0.0.0.0:${cfg.port}" alongside the firewall rule. Verified with a scratch nixosSystem eval (config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath resolved cleanly, same technique used for Phase 2) rather than the suggested --eval on a bare function, which proves nothing.

Replaced the old dead Vault/sops-nix OIDC placeholder wholesale. Verified for real this time (not a scratch nixosSystem, the actual host wiring through base.nix + colmenaHive): `colmena build --on @auth` completed end-to-end and produced a full system closure. Did not import ../modules/colmena.nix -- checked hosts/media-center.nix (the closest analogous plain-application host) and it doesn't import it either; that module is opt-in per-host (custom.colmena.enable), not a required import.

tasks.task: Add agenix secrets declarations for zitadel
tasks.note: Deviated from 'root for passwords': owner is 'postgres' (not root) for zitadel-postgres-password and zitadel-postgres-admin-password, because modules/zitadel.nix's postgresql-zitadel-password unit runs its ALTER USER script as User = "postgres" and needs to read those files directly -- root reading a 0400 postgres-owned file is unaffected since root bypasses unix permission checks anyway (the root-run zitadel-secrets unit still reads them fine). Also added a 4th secret (zitadel-admin-password, owner root, since only the root-run zitadel-secrets unit reads it) matching the admin-password.age added in Phase 2/1.7.
acceptance_criteria: age.secrets.zitadel-master-key defined with file path and permissions
Owner set appropriately (zitadel for master-key, root for passwords)
Mode set to '400' for all secrets

tasks.note: clientSecretFile/cookieSecretFile are intentionally left unset (not just empty strings) since the module lazily evaluates them only inside a mkIf cfg.enable block, and enable = false here -- setting them to a nonexistent secret path would be pointless and setting them to a real one is impossible since Phase 8 hasn't created those secrets yet.
acceptance_criteria: Comments indicate this will be enabled after Zitadel UI config

tasks.note: Deliberately NOT done yet, despite being straightforward to write -- doing it now would break production. ~20 already-existing routers (audiobooks, faasd-portal, and 18 others) already list this middleware by name in their `middlewares` array, so as soon as it's uncommented, every one of those routes starts doing ForwardAuth against http://192.168.50.125:4180/oauth2/auth. But custom.oauth2-proxy.enable stays false on the auth host until task 9.3, and Phase 7 in between is manual UI clicking that can take days. Uncommenting now would mean connection-refused/502 on all ~20 routes for that entire window (oauth-errors below only catches 401-403, not 502, so it wouldn't even redirect to a login page). The corrected content (real address, real header list, and dropping the addAuthCookiesToResponse placeholder since the real oauth2-proxy cookie is _oauth2_proxy, not Session-Cookie/State-Cookie) is written into the comment block in modules/traefik.nix so this is a single find-and-uncomment when task 9.3 flips enable = true -- do both in the same change, then deploy auth and networking together.
acceptance_criteria: authResponseHeaders includes: X-Auth-Request-User, X-Auth-Request-Email, X-Auth-Request-Access-Token, Authorization

tasks.note: Same reasoning and same commit as 5.3 -- see that task's note. Corrected content (errors.service = 'oauth2-proxy-backend', matching the renamed service from 5.2) is already written into the comment block.

Safe to do now (unlike 5.3/5.4): only the 'zitadel' router (auth.goobtube.tv) references this, and that router isn't deployed/reachable until Phase 6 anyway. Was actually necessary regardless of oauth2-proxy readiness -- Zitadel's own login page needs this middleware to be real, not commented out.

Named distinctly from the pre-existing 'oauth2-proxy-route' router (Host(oauth.goobtube.tv) && PathPrefix(/), service oauth-backend) which belongs to the same unrelated legacy deployment as 'oauth-backend' -- left untouched. Verified with an isolated scratch nixosSystem eval; a real colmena build --on @networking isn't possible right now due to the unrelated claude-code.nix/nodePackages breakage noted on task 5.1.
